description:
No spec subject — bookkeeping epic.

Impromptu epic created 2026-07-26 to land four independently-surfaced follow-up tickets on a SINGLE PR. Children were each carved by an earlier ticket's cold verification or critical review and had no owning epic (gai was reparented here from specled_-xkn; xkn retains its other three children).

Children and the subjects they advance:
  - specled_-48i  specled.package      content-lint verification for adoption_guide/concepts_guide must requirements
  - specled_-vk0  specled.package      doc-identifier lint hardening (lookbehind bounds, severity-corpus asymmetry, digit codes, stale-marker sweep, two-way mirror)
  - specled_-gai  specled.spec_review  retire duplicated coverage_tab_bind_closure compound statement, repoint lib/** covers markers
  - specled_-ymn  specled.verification cross_vm_temp_names ADR vs hash_store fixed-name .tmp sibling; tracer pid-separation falsifiability; ADR affects: reach

Sequencing rationale: 48i and vk0 both edit .spec/specs/package.spec.md (48i the adoption_guide/concepts_guide verification entries, vk0 the decisions: list plus must wording), so 48i blocks vk0 to avoid a real same-file merge conflict. gai and ymn touch disjoint specs and lib files and run concurrently with 48i.

Orchestrated by /orchestrate-epic. Implementers: Codex. Verify/audit/rebase: Claude.

Generated/derived state policy for this epic:
  - .spec/state.json — derived, untracked, gitignored; never review scope, never committed. Regenerate with `mix spec.index --output .spec/state.json`.
  - .spec/realization_hashes.json — COMMITTED baseline, NOT free generated state. Per .claude/rules/specled.md a rebase worker must NOT resolve conflicts here by regenerating (that silently absorbs realization drift). On conflict prefer the side whose branch legitimately changed the named bindings, or keep both entries when different bindings moved.

Merge gate for this repo (host mix, no compose):
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check
Hash inputs for the unchanged-tree skip: lib, test, config, priv, mix.lock, .spec.
